The '''Ado sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> It included the territory of the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]] such as [[Indupar/Legends|Indupar]] and [[Ec Pand]], and also [[StarForge Station]], an illegal [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]].

==History==
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Irnst Stavveld]] governed the sector during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], and was tasked with locating and destroying StarForge Station. Although the sector appears to have been relatively lightly garrisoned: the space-lanes of the Induparan Crown Worlds were protected by a single [[Systems force|Force Escort]] squadron.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Ado sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
